events.title: Lunenburg Farmers Market
events.description: Weekly farmers market with local produce, meat, seafood, baked goods, and artisan vendors.

events.title: South Shore Shunpike — Open Studio Crawl
events.description: 3rd annual open studio crawl featuring painters, photographers, printmakers, folk artists, rug hookers/weavers, and more. Free wharf-to-wharf water taxi between galleries.

events.title: Capella Regalis Spring Concert
events.description: Free concert featuring Halifax Men, Boys & Girls Choirs alongside Capella Regalis South Shore Program choristers. Directed by Nick Halley and Vanessa Halley, with Paul Halley on organ and piano. Free-will offering at the door, no reservation required.

events.title: Robert Thomas & the Sessionmen
events.description: East Coast Music Awards “Entertainer of the Year” nominee Robert Thomas is a natural storyteller. With an energetic and welcoming voice, he highlights the stories of our lives with empathy, energy and humour. Based in Moncton, New Brunswick, Robert has written for artists across many genres including Bonnie Raitt, The Dixie Chicks, Kenny Rogers and Mister Mister, as well as for corporate advertising.

events.title: Tunes on Tuesday: Composition Academy
events.description: Get a glimpse behind the scenes as the 2026 Composition Academy artists present their works in progress in this informal read-through session. Combining elements of a rehearsal and a masterclass, the event offers a unique opportunity to hear new music as it develops and to observe the collaborative process between composers, performers ( Jeff Reilly (bass clarinet), Peter Togni (piano), and India Gailey ) and faculty ( Matthias McIntire , Roydon Tse , and Dinuk Wijeratne ).

events.title: "Wooden Building Pathology" RAIC Public Lecture by Gregory MacNeil
events.description: “Wooden Building Pathology” – Public Lecture Presented by the South Shore Network of the Royal Architectural Institute of Canada (RAIC) LECTURE BY GREGORY MACNEIL Thursday, June 18, 7:00 p.m. Buildings, like people, can develop problems as they age. “Building pathology” is the study of what goes wrong in buildings, why it happens, and how to fix it. It looks at leaks, cracks, decay, and other issues by examining how materials, structure, and people interact with weather and daily use. This…

events.title: Henry Purcell's Dido and Aeneas in Concert
events.description: Maritime Concert Opera presents Henry Purcell's Dido and Aeneas. Professional soloists joined by the MCO chorus and the Blue Engine String Quartet.

events.title: Jazz at LAMP: The Music of Miles Davis
events.description: Whether you're a long-time jazz lover or new to the genre, the Jazz Concert Series at LAMP promises to be a musical experience that will leave you spellbound. The LAMP Libations bar will be open - have a drink, hear some great jazz, and then head out to one of the many incredible restaurants in Lunenburg, Mahone Bay or Chester. What a fabulous night out!

events.title: Shawna Caspi
events.description: Shawna Caspi is a folk-roots singer-songwriter who can make a room full of people feel like they’re hanging out with an old friend in a plush corner booth. She takes her time crafting lyrics that are poetic and meaningful, often using unusual rhymes and surprising turns of phrase. Shawna spent years on the road, playing festivals and concert halls, train cars, backyards, and living rooms, supporting her warm voice with intricate fingerstyle guitar accompaniment, and drawing energy from shifting landscapes and long drives through Canada and the United States. Her songs resonate with stories…

events.title: Composition Academy 2026 Showcase
events.description: Throughout the Academy, this year’s cohort of young and emerging composers will work closely with celebrated composers and educators Matthias McIntire , Roydon Tse , and Dinuk Wijeratne while developing original works to be performed by the Blackwood Trio . Featuring Jeff Reilly on bass clarinet, Peter Togni on piano, and India Gailey on cello, the Trio will bring a collaborative and improvisational approach to the composition process.
